text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, the race said to determine the strongest Umamusume, and Symboli Rudolf is the picture of composure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is one crown she will not give up. We step forward, our sights set higher than ever.
